data.exact_reserve_text:
The GAAP calendar year result reflects the application of a prudent reserving policy, the outcome of a full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book of business and reserve strengthening in certain classes, in particular non-marine liability construction.
The syndicate has written a reinsurance to close RITC forthe liabilities relating to the 2017 and prior year of accounts of Syndicate 1969 and the RITC of the 2018 year of account of Syndicate 3330 in its first year of inception.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to close of Syndicate 1969 (2017 & prior)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance to close transferred liabilities from Syndicate 1969 (2017 and prior) into Syndicate 1994; RITC and subsequent reserving review contributed to reserve strengthening and distorts year-on-year development comparators.

RITC of the 2018 year of account of Syndicate 3330 was assumed in the syndicate's first year; the full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book resulted in reserve strengthening in certain classes.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1994's 2021 results reflect the assumption of reinsurance-to-close liabilities (Syndicate 1969: 2017 & prior; Syndicate 3330: 2018) and a full reserving review which led to a prudent reserving stance and reserve strengthening, particularly in non-marine liability (casualty) lines. No explicit gross prior-year movement amount is disclosed; the claims development triangle is present but is materially affected by the RITC transactions which distort direct PYD measurement.
raw_causal_phrases: the outcome of a full reserving review of the Syndicate 3330 book of business
reserve strengthening in certain classes, in particular non-marine liability construction
has written a reinsurance to close RITC for the liabilities relating to the 2017 and prior year of accounts of Syndicate 1969 and the RITC of the 2018 year of account of Syndicate 3330

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure is disclosed. The syndicate assumed significant RITC balances (Synd 1969 2017&prior and Synd 3330 2018) in its first year; this RITC activity distorts claims development triangle comparisons and makes triangle-based PYD calculations unreliable. Opening (1 Jan 2021) gross claims outstanding is not presented as a prior-year comparative on the balance sheet; therefore opening_reserves is null. The direction (strengthening) is derived from explicit narrative stating reserve strengthening after a reserving review.
